card.name: Inside bacterial genus names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a bacterial genus name, mainly "ers" in Yersinia and "ig" in Shigella. It also fires on the last letter of BCG.

modes.label: Yersinia
modes.description: The "ers" piece after Y in Yersinia pestis, enterocolitica or pseudotuberculosis.

modes.label: Shigella and BCG
modes.description: A middle or final piece of other bacterial names such as Shigella or BCG.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like bacteria and antibiotic coming next, since the name is only partly spelled out.
card.plain: It fires partway through the spelling of germ names like Yersinia and Shigella.
